The isolated scalar objective is smoothL1(p,g)+0.25*relu(0.05-sign(g)*p) for active labels. Actual controller averages all gain losses and active margin losses separately, so per-active-label relative margin coefficient is0.25*n/m (>=0.25), and one shared network couples candidates/states. The toy proves a conflict for small nonzero labels, not its aggregate causal contribution to DEV decline. SmoothL1 minimizes a Huber location functional in expectation, not generally the conditional mean; mean interpretation needs the quadratic-residual condition plus model/optimization/calibration evidence. No such final-model expectation/calibration evidence is provided.
Frame/confidence rule triggers are not logged tensor writes or observed template corruption. Pairwise TRAIN sampled-request advantages are not full-pool or trajectory-level oracle bounds.
